subject: Request: Quick TrustRadius write-up + $100 thank-you card
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Quick TrustRadius write-up + $100 thank-you card

Hi Jared —

Hope all is well on your end. We really appreciate how quickly your team onboarded Redwood last quarter; the latency wins you shared in the customer meeting were super helpful for our benchmarking content.

If you have 10–15 minutes this week, would you be willing to post a short review on TrustRadius describing how Redwood impacted your inference costs and reliability? We find short, candid notes from engineers help other teams evaluate production readiness more than marketing copy.

To make it easy I attached a one-paragraph template and a draft case-study excerpt (feel free to use nothing or everything). Once you submit, we’ll send a $100 Amazon gift card as a small thank-you.

TrustRadius link: https://app.trustradius.com/write-review/Acme-Integration

If it helps, Lina or I can jump on a 10-minute call to walk through talking points.

Thanks again — really appreciate any time you can spare.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trustradius-template.txt (text); case-study-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmecorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quick TrustRadius write-up + $100 thank-you card

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the ping. A couple quick Qs: 1) Is the gift card tied to any public quote approval process? 2) Who will control the case-study excerpt if we want changes?

We can probably get a short review up next week; Lina and I will sync and confirm.

—Jared
Head of Core Platform
Acme Corp

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quick TrustRadius write-up + $100 thank-you card

Hi Jared —

Great questions. Short answers below and happy to elaborate on a quick call.

1) Gift card: The $100 Amazon card is just a thank-you for the effort; it does not require additional public approval beyond the review text you post on TrustRadius. If you want a short approval for the case-study excerpt we attached, we’ll route edits through your legal/PR contact before publishing.

2) Case-study control: You retain final sign-off for any customer quote or case-study. We don’t publish anything with a customer quote without explicit written approval.

If Lina is comfortable, we’ll plan to send the link and have marketing prepare the gift card once the review is live. Marcus (cc’d) will handle issuing the card.

Would a Tuesday morning (Aug 5) 10-minute sync work for Lina and you?

Thanks —
Rachel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quick TrustRadius write-up + $100 thank-you card

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clarifications. Aug 5 at 10am PT works for a short call. Quick note: procurement prefers gift cards to be invoiced as a marketing expense; we’ll confirm if we need anything from Redwood on that front.

I’ll be the reviewer; Jared might chime in with one sentence about latency improvements.

Lina
Senior Engineer, Core Platform
Acme Corp
